description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-SEOS-01
**Title:** Heading structure on Bi Fuel Trucks [hi] matches the stored snapshot
**Language:** hi

**Description:**
Open Bi Fuel Trucks (hi) and compare live SEO headings with the snapshot. Allure and artifacts/seo-structure-report.xlsx show expected vs actual so a changed heading can be copied into test data after it is confirmed.

**Expected Result:**
Every stored heading on Bi Fuel Trucks (hi) is still present with the same tag. Extra or missing headings fail the check; order on the page may differ.

**Steps:**
1. Open Bi Fuel Trucks (hi)
2. Expand Read More if the About block is collapsed
3. Compare live headings with the stored snapshot
